# International Marine Automations (IMA)

> Marine electrical, electronics and automation repair, based in Piraeus, Greece. From board-level component repair to full electrical refit, on board in port, underway or in the shipyard — with a 24/7 breakdown line and engineers sent worldwide.

The site is in English and Greek: English pages are at the paths below, and each has a Greek version under `/el` (for example `/el/services`). Breakdown reports go through the contact page; the office replies with an engineer and an arrival time.

## Pages

- [Home](https://imagreece.gr/): Marine electrical and automation repair. From board-level component repair to full electrical refit. 24/7 breakdown response.
- [Services](https://imagreece.gr/services): Three levels of repair: board, system, full electrical refit. All in-house, no subcontractors — on site, at anchor or in the yard.
- [Capabilities](https://imagreece.gr/capabilities): The systems and makers we work on — PLCs, drives, inverters, switchboards, alarm and monitoring systems, any manufacturer.
- [Projects](https://imagreece.gr/projects): Real faults on real vessels: what failed, what we did, and how long until the ship was back in service.
- [Spare parts](https://imagreece.gr/spare-parts): Photos of PCBs, drives, PLC modules and power supplies we have repaired at component level in our workshop.
- [Certifications](https://imagreece.gr/certifications): The certifications and class approvals covering our work, so the repair passes survey.
- [Coverage](https://imagreece.gr/coverage): Based in Piraeus, covering the main Greek ports permanently or regularly, and travelling to wherever the vessel is.
- [Report a breakdown](https://imagreece.gr/contact): Send vessel name, IMO, port and ETA. We reply with an engineer and an arrival time, not a quotation.
